Privacy Policy

Last updated: November 26, 2026

Dirt Dawn ("we," "us") respects your privacy. This policy explains what personal information we collect at dirtdawn.solutions, why, and the choices you have.

1. Information We Collect

  • Order information: name, shipping and billing address, email address, phone number, and order details when you make a purchase.
  • Payment information: handled by our payment processors; we never see or store your full card number.
  • Account information: email and password if you create an account.
  • Usage data: pages visited and basic device information, collected through cookies — see our Cookie Policy.

2. How We Use Your Information

We use your information to process and ship orders, provide customer support, send order updates, prevent fraud, improve the Site, and — only if you opt in — send you marketing email. You can unsubscribe at any time using the link in any email.

3. Sharing Your Information

We share information only with service providers who need it to run our business: payment processors, shipping carriers, email delivery, and hosting. We do not sell your personal information to anyone.

4. Data Retention

We keep order records as long as required for tax and accounting purposes, and other personal data only as long as needed for the purposes above.

5. Your Rights

You may request a copy of your personal information, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it, subject to legal record-keeping duties. Residents of US state privacy jurisdictions (for example California and Virginia) may exercise additional rights under applicable state law. Contact us at the address below to make a request.

6. Security

The Site is served over HTTPS and we apply industry-standard safeguards. No method of transmission or storage is perfectly secure, but we work to protect your data.

7. Children

The Site is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect their personal information.

8. Changes to This Policy

We post any updates on this page with a new "Last updated" date.

Shipping & Delivery Policy

Last updated: November 26, 2026

This policy explains how Dirt Dawn ships orders placed at dirtdawn.solutions.

1. Processing Time

Orders are prepared and handed to the carrier within 1–2 business days (Monday–Friday, excluding U.S. federal holidays). Orders placed on weekends or holidays are processed the next business day.

2. Shipping Destinations and Rates

We currently ship within the United States. Shipping rates and any free-shipping threshold are shown at checkout before you pay.

3. Delivery Time

Delivery takes roughly 3–7 business days after your order ships, depending on the carrier and destination. Busy periods and weather can cause delays; we appreciate your patience.

4. Tracking

You receive a tracking number by email as soon as your order ships. If tracking has not updated within 7 business days, contact us and we will look into it.

5. Address Errors

Please double-check your address at checkout. If a package is returned to us because of an incorrect or incomplete address, we can reship it at your cost. Contact us as soon as possible if you spot a mistake — we can usually correct it before the order ships.

6. Lost or Damaged Packages

If your package arrives damaged or goes missing, email us within 14 days of the delivery date (or of the last tracking update) with your order number and a photo if applicable, and we will make it right.

Returns & Refunds Policy

Last updated: November 26, 2026

If something is not right, we want to fix it. This policy explains how returns and refunds work at dirtdawn.solutions.

1. Return Window

You may return unworn, unwashed items with original tags within 30 days of delivery for a refund to your original payment method.

2. How to Start a Return

  • Email dirtndawn@hotmail.com with your order number and the item(s) you want to return.
  • We reply with return instructions and the return address.
  • Ship the items back; we recommend a trackable service.

3. Refunds

Once your return arrives and passes inspection, we refund the item price (plus any applicable tax) to your original payment method within 5–10 business days. Original shipping charges are non-refundable unless the return is our fault.

4. Defective or Wrong Items

If an item arrives damaged, defective or not the one you ordered, tell us within 14 days of delivery with a photo and your order number. We cover return shipping and offer a replacement or full refund.

5. Exclusions

Items marked "final sale" and gift cards cannot be returned unless defective.

6. Exchanges

For a different size or colour, return the original item and place a new order — that is the fastest way to get the size you want.

Cancellation Policy

Last updated: November 26, 2026

This policy explains when and how you can cancel an order placed at dirtdawn.solutions.

1. Cancelling Before Shipment

You may cancel an order for a full refund as long as it has not yet shipped. Email dirtndawn@hotmail.com as soon as possible with your order number and the subject line "Cancel order #..." — we process cancellations within 1 business day.

2. Cancelling After Shipment

Once an order has shipped we cannot stop the carrier. Refuse the delivery if you are present, or accept it and use our Returns & Refunds Policy to send it back for a refund.

3. Cancellations by Us

We may cancel an order if an item is out of stock, the price was wrong, or the payment cannot be verified. You receive a full refund to the original payment method and an email explaining what happened.

4. Refund Timing

Approved cancellations are refunded within 5–10 business days, depending on your bank or card issuer.

Payment Policy

Last updated: November 26, 2026

This policy explains how payment works when you shop at dirtdawn.solutions.

1. Accepted Payment Methods

We accept major credit and debit cards: Visa, Mastercard and American Express. Available payment methods are shown at checkout and may vary by region.

2. When You Are Charged

Your card is authorised and charged when you place the order. If an item is unavailable and we cancel that part of your order, the corresponding amount is refunded to your original payment method.

3. Currency and Taxes

All charges are in U.S. dollars (USD). Sales tax is calculated at checkout based on the shipping address and applicable law.

4. Payment Security

Checkout is encrypted over HTTPS and processed by our payment provider. Dirt Dawn never sees or stores your full card number. Your card statement will show the charge as "Dirt Dawn" (or a close variant we display at checkout).

5. Failed or Declined Payments

If a payment is declined, no order is created and you are not charged. Check your card details and billing address, or try another card. Contact your bank if the problem continues.

6. Pricing Errors

If a product is listed at an incorrect price, we may cancel the affected order and refund you in full, even after a confirmation email was sent.

Warranty Policy

Last updated: November 26, 2026

Dirt Dawn gear is built to last. This policy explains the limited warranty that covers products bought at dirtdawn.solutions.

1. One-Year Limited Warranty

Dirt Dawn warrants its products against defects in materials and workmanship for one (1) year from the date of delivery, when used for their intended purpose. If a product fails because of a manufacturing defect within that period, we repair or replace it — or, if it is no longer available, refund you.

2. What Is Not Covered

  • Normal wear and tear (outsoles, straps, fabric pilling, fading).
  • Damage from misuse, improper washing, accidents or modification.
  • Items bought from anyone other than Dirt Dawn or its authorised sellers.

3. Making a Warranty Claim

  • Email dirtndawn@hotmail.com with your order number, a description of the problem, and photos showing the defect.
  • If the claim is approved, we explain the repair, replacement or refund and any next steps.

4. Your Legal Rights

This warranty gives you specific legal rights, and you may also have other rights that vary from state to state.

Cookie Policy

Last updated: November 26, 2026

This Cookie Policy explains how Dirt Dawn uses cookies at dirtdawn.solutions.

1. What Are Cookies

Cookies are small text files a website stores on your device. We also use similar technologies such as local storage. They help the site work, remember your preferences and understand how it is used.

2. Cookies We Use

  • Essential cookies — required for the cart, checkout and security. The site cannot function without them.
  • Preference cookies — remember choices such as language and region.
  • Analytics cookies — help us understand which pages are visited so we can improve the Site. Data is aggregated.
  • Session cookies — keep you signed in while you browse and expire when you close your browser.

3. Managing Cookies

You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings at any time. If you disable essential cookies, parts of the store — such as the cart and checkout — will not work.

4. Third-Party Cookies

Some embedded content or payment tools may set their own cookies. We keep third-party cookies to the minimum needed to run the store.

5. Changes to This Policy

We post any updates on this page with a new "Last updated" date.
